source: The unchanged A3-1 four-fold OOF model, with its maximum local-edit score recorded per query; no retraining or score recalibration
selection: Within each held-out fold, select up to floor(fraction * fold query count) positive-margin proposed edits ranked by OOF margin; all others STAY. This batch-relative ranking is diagnostic, not an online deployable threshold.
metrics: For every fraction, all five anchor counts, Complete, repairs/breaks, normalized cumulative context and paired token delta against the same V8 quality-depth10 baseline
decision: If even tiny high-margin subsets have substantial quality breaks, close the present frozen-feature linear editor; do not tune a threshold on the same OOF outcomes. A positive low-risk region would require a separately frozen online threshold and independent validation.
